# mpg123 1.33.7

Unmodified upstream source release: https://www.mpg123.de/download/mpg123-1.33.7.tar.bz2

SHA-256: `31d0e35a4ca567ec9b5ebda6c3062bb4435d6d3eacd6ef0d95cadd7854dc03ee`.
The archive includes the complete corresponding source, COPYING, AUTHORS, and
individual component notices. The adjacent COPYING/AUTHORS are unmodified copies.

The repository wrapper builds the upstream `ports/cmake` project as a shared
library. No Xash3D FWGS integration source, custom I/O stub or Waf build is copied.
The decoder is LGPL 2.1; retain the upstream license/source with binary distributions
and allow replacement of the shared library under the applicable LGPL conditions.
See COPYING for the complete terms and component exceptions.
